title: Steepleaf
lead: The world’s tea knowledge, connected — leaf to land to cup, with explainable discovery and no social rankings.
mission: Build an interconnected understanding of tea: regions, producers, cultivars, processing, flavor, brewing, history, science, and where to learn more.
principles: Every fact connects to related knowledge
Demo and sample data are labeled honestly

modules.title: Knowledge graph
modules.description: Normalized entities and typed relationships across tea, place, craft, sensory, culture, and science.

modules.title: Explore & search
modules.description: Fielded search by name, flavor, place, producer, cultivar, processing, brewing, price, and more.

modules.title: Discovery lenses
modules.description: Similar teas, more floral, sweeter, more oxidized, lighter roast, value, seasonal greens — each with a reason.

modules.title: Entity education pages
modules.description: Overview, quick facts, timeline, map hints, relations, AI summary, shopping samples, unknowns.

modules.title: Graph-grounded AI
modules.description: Deterministic answers from the sample graph — uniqueness, comparisons, next cups, price filters.

modules.title: Private catalog & brew journal
modules.description: On-device teas and brew notes — separate from the public educational graph.

modules.title: Marketplace feeds & vision
modules.description: Vendor APIs, barcode/OCR/label recognition, and photo ID — architected, not shipped.

dataModel: Shared Steepleaf KG package under design-system/steepleaf/. Personal catalog/journal stay on-device. Vendor offers are sample edges, not checkout.
privacyPhilosophy: Brew notes stay private. No follower counts, influencers, or engagement tricks. Educational recommendations only.
futureDirection: Expand coverage, vendor feeds, scientific citations, and vision/OCR identification — still educational-first.
